import os
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
import xgboost as xgb

# Suppress warnings and progress bars
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")
xgb.set_config(verbosity=0)

# Define paths
input_dir = "./input"
submission_dir = "./submission"
os.makedirs(submission_dir, exist_ok=True)

# Load Data
train_df = pd.read_csv(os.path.join(input_dir, "train.csv"))
test_df = pd.read_csv(os.path.join(input_dir, "test.csv"))
sample_submission = pd.read_csv(os.path.join(input_dir, "sample_submission.csv"))

# Feature Engineering
# f_27 is high cardinality (670k unique in 800k rows), likely noise. Dropping it is standard practice.
# Keep numeric and low cardinality features.
features = [c for c in train_df.columns if c not in ["id", "target", "f_27"]]

X_train = train_df[features]
y_train = train_df["target"]
X_test = test_df[features]
test_ids = test_df["id"]

# Convert all features to float for consistent XGBoost handling
X_train = X_train.astype(float)
X_test = X_test.astype(float)

# Split Train for Validation (Hold-out with stratification to preserve class distribution)
X_tr, X_val, y_tr, y_val = train_test_split(
    X_train, y_train, test_size=0.2, random_state=42, stratify=y_train
)

# Create evaluation set for early stopping
eval_set = [(X_val, y_val)]

# Initialize and Train Model on Train Split WITH EARLY STOPPING
model = xgb.XGBClassifier(
    objective="binary:logistic",
    eval_metric="auc",
    use_label_encoder=False,
    tree_method="hist",
    random_state=42,
    verbosity=0,
    early_stopping_rounds=50,
    n_estimators=600,
    learning_rate=0.08,
)
model.fit(X_tr, y_tr, eval_set=eval_set)

# Evaluate on Validation Set (Genuine hold-out evaluation)
y_val_pred = model.predict_proba(X_val)[:, 1]
val_auc = roc_auc_score(y_val, y_val_pred)
print(f"Validation AUC-ROC Score: {val_auc:.6f}")

# Retrain on Full Training Data for final predictions (no early stopping for full data)
model_full = xgb.XGBClassifier(
    objective="binary:logistic",
    eval_metric="auc",
    use_label_encoder=False,
    tree_method="hist",
    random_state=42,
    verbosity=0,
)
model_full.fit(X_train, y_train)

# Predict on Test Data
y_test_pred = model_full.predict_proba(X_test)[:, 1]

# Create Submission DataFrame
submission_df = pd.DataFrame({"id": test_ids.values, "target": y_test_pred})

# Save Submission
output_path = os.path.join(submission_dir, "submission.csv")
submission_df.to_csv(output_path, index=False)
print(f"Submission saved to {output_path} with {len(submission_df)} rows")
